title: Agents and evidence per kind, second half: the benchmark, the pitfalls, the lessons and the tracks by kind
request: The open halves of 16.14: the benchmark reporting by kind with intervals, pitfalls measured per kind, each kind's traps in a new benchmark version, lessons filed by kind, a track per kind. Done when an agent's method question cites the kind's evidence and the benchmark reports per kind with intervals.
spec: Benchmark v4 filing every case by kind with the replicas' traps and a sealed set frozen before its run; pitfalls measured on each tabular replica; lessons carrying the kind; tracks about each kind.
plan: Survey the benchmark, pitfalls, lessons, tracks and the evidence index.
Write benchmark v4 by kind and freeze its sealed set.
Measure each kind's pitfalls on its replica.
Give regression and places tracks; list each track's kinds.
Review, fix before the freeze, commit, run from the commit.

decisions.decision: Kinds the scripted policies cannot judge are said as not judged and read by their acceptance.
decisions.why: An empty interval must never read as a pass.

decisions.decision: Results of a run made before the review's fixes, never committed, were removed and run again from the commit.
decisions.why: A record must come from the code it names.

decisions.decision: The sealed replica seeds start after every seed a campaign read.
decisions.why: A sealed case must be unseen by every rule.

change: dclab_rnd/agent_eval/benchmark_v4.py and its sealed file, by_kind.py, run.py, dclab_rnd/pitfalls_by_kind.py, evidence_index.py, tools.py, lessons.py, research_map.py, kinds regression and places, research/tabular-regression and places-and-spatial, campaigns benchmark_v4 and pitfalls_by_kind_v1, KND-019 and KND-020, the knowledge base and track indexes, Makefile; tests/test_kinds_by_kind.py (new); the playbook, the roadmap, CLAUDE.md.

findings.defect: The first dev run of the new benchmark stopped on the scorer's case lookup.
findings.scenario: Summarizing the results looked the trap up in v2 and v3 only and raised on a v4 case.
findings.cause: The scorer knew the frozen benchmarks by name.
findings.fix: The lookup falls back to v4.

findings.defect: The random split's cost was too noisy to read from one holdout draw.
findings.scenario: On the places replica one block draw gave a gap from 5800 to 20000 across seeds.
findings.cause: A single random holdout and a single block draw per seed.
findings.fix: Five draws of each, averaged per seed.

findings.defect: The generated evidence index was not rebuilt.
findings.scenario: The new pitfall records were missing from the index agents read, and the new test failed.
findings.fix: Rebuilt after the runs, in the same commit.

findings.defect: Stored results named the old tracks.
findings.scenario: The places and regression acceptance records named driving-maps and time-series-forecasting.
findings.cause: The tracks changed after those runs.
findings.fix: Both kinds' acceptance and the pitfalls rerun from the committed code into new records.

findings.defect: The sealed set included a replica seed already read.
findings.scenario: Seed 2 of the replicas had been run and read by the kinds' acceptance and the pitfalls.
findings.cause: The sealed seeds overlapped the campaigns' seeds.
findings.fix: Sealed replica seeds 3 to 5, before the freeze; the limitation that v3's test generators were scored before restored.

findings.defect: The text kind's leak cost was measured against a baseline without the text.
findings.scenario: The review text was dropped as a row key, so the clean model scored below chance and the leak looked worth 0.51.
findings.cause: Every many-valued text column was taken for a key.
findings.fix: The kind's text is read through words weighted on the training rows only; the cost is 0.12.

findings.defect: One of regression's two leaks was named but never modelled.
findings.scenario: The delivery's end time is a time, and times were left out, so only the rating counted.
findings.cause: Time columns were dropped from the features.
findings.fix: A time is modelled as its seconds after the row's own time; only modelled leaks are named; the cost is 8.3 minutes.

findings.defect: A gap inside its noise was claimed as looking better.
findings.scenario: A random split's 0.0031 minutes on regression, with an interval across zero, read as a flattering split.
findings.cause: The claim wording ignored the interval.
findings.fix: An interval holding zero is said as no difference measured, with why.

findings.defect: Replica cases tested the leak only.
findings.scenario: The binary replica's time and the regression replica's entity were not expected.
findings.fix: Each replica case expects its time and its entity.

findings.defect: False alarms on replica cases were measured on a few columns or none.
findings.scenario: The text kind showed zero false alarms of zero, read as a pass.
findings.fix: The replica's honest columns are listed; a count of zero is said as not measured.

findings.defect: The generated track indexes would go stale on commit.
findings.cause: Generated before the files were added.

findings.defect: The interval assumed three seeds, and blocks held out another share.
findings.scenario: Any other number of seeds used the three-seed t value; block draws held out a fifth of blocks, not of rows.
findings.fix: The t value by seeds; blocks drawn until they hold the same share of rows.

findings.defect: Older lessons are never found by kind.
findings.scenario: A lesson accepted before 16.14 has no kind in its scope.
findings.cause: The kind is written at acceptance.
findings.fix: Said in the function: the kind is never guessed.

measurements.name: benchmark v4 by kind
measurements.gate: the benchmark reports results per kind with intervals
measurements.result: leaks caught and false alarms per kind and policy with Wilson intervals for binary, regression, rare_event and text_tabular, on dev and on the sealed set run once; on the sealed replica cases the audit kept 0 of 3 regression leaks out
measurements.against_gate: per kind and policy with intervals for the kinds named; every other kind said as not judged and read by its acceptance
limits: Cases of one replica are not independent.

measurements.name: pitfalls per kind
measurements.gate: each tabular kind's pitfalls measured on its replica
measurements.result: a kept leak inflates every kind measured (0.3361 ROC-AUC on binary, 8.2786 minutes on regression, 0.1166 on text_tabular); a random split flatters places by 19486.9478 against blocks; no difference measured on replicas without drift
measurements.against_gate: every tabular kind named measured on its replica
limits: Invented replicas and one model family.

outcome: Every benchmark case is filed by its kind, results and pitfalls are reported per kind with intervals, lessons carry their kind, and each kind's track lists its evidence.
lessons: Fix what a reviewer finds before freezing a sealed set: after it, nothing can change.
A baseline that lost its best input makes any leak look large.
An interval that holds zero is a measurement of nothing, and must be said so.
risks: The scripted policies judge four kinds only.
Images wait on a local encoder.
